title: Before the launch
description: Before the launch, Yazdovsky took Laika home to play with his children. 'Laika was quiet and charming ... I wanted to do something nice for her: She had so little time left to live.'

title: Sputnik 2 Launch
description: Sputnik 2 was launched by the Soviet Union, carrying Laika into orbit. This marked the first time a living creature was sent into space.

title: Laika in Orbit
description: During the first hours of the mission, Laika experienced stress due to high G-forces, tight confines, and elevated temperatures inside the spacecraft.

title: Death of Laika
description: Laika passed away from overheating and stress within hours of launch. Originally, the Soviets claimed she survived several days.

title: Legacy of Laika
description: The true circumstances of Laika’s death were revealed in 2002. She remains a symbol of early space exploration and the ethical considerations of sending animals to space.
